say: Let's look at your Account page, where you manage everything on Stall.
Tap Account, at the bottom right. At the top, you'll see your name, your matric number, and your school.
These shortcuts open your messages, orders people placed with you, group collections, invites and credit, your payment receipts, and your badges.
Under Selling, you can turn on delivery, get a verified seller badge, and share your Stall QR code.
Under Your profile, verify that you're a student. It builds trust, and helps you sell faster. You can also add your email, and change your password.
Turn on notifications, so you never miss an order. Choose light or dark mode. And read How Stall works, any time.
If you ever need help, buyer protection, the terms, and privacy are right at the bottom. That's your Account page. See you in the next video!
